items.mainDefect: When the join deadline expires, breaking out of the loop prevents termination of the remaining processes.

secondary.defect: The isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) guard rejects SpawnProcess instances, so join() never calls terminate() on them.

items.mainDefect: The isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) guard rejects SpawnProcess instances, preventing hung flushers from being killed before replacement.

secondary.defect: The same incorrect type guard in join() prevents terminate() from running on spawned flusher processes.
